## Trust model and data flow

Hosted and BYOC retain customer-local execution/content and stable workspace identity. Customer-authored source, plans/work items, prompts, transcripts, model I/O and diagnostic content are customer-side data. The vendor control plane receives allowlisted control metadata and commercial facts only: organization/workspace identifiers, versioned entitlement and price references, counters, provider bill amounts, operation/receipt identifiers and resource disposition.

The customer runtime must remain usable during vendor outage. No model call may require an online vendor-control metadata round trip. Provider/model requests go from the authorized customer runtime to OpenRouter/upstream providers; those are declared third parties and must meet the selected retention policy. BYOK customers control their provider account and keys; managed-key custody requires explicit service scope and limits. Do not centralize raw prompts to simplify invoices.

Transport endpoint identity, generation/revocation, browser-code delivery and key recovery are part of the promise. Vendor-served JavaScript with TLS/base64, vendor-root VM access or storage residency alone cannot establish vendor-unreadability. Reuse the sealed-channel/content-marker and outage checks; disclose the real hosted trust boundary.

BYOC grants are scoped, auditable and revocable. The customer pays its cloud directly; the separate management invoice covers Papercusp operations. A budget cannot cap unrelated spending in the customer's cloud account. Hosted caps apply to admitted Papercusp-managed exposure and explicitly disclosed retained-resource liability.

## Launch prerequisites and owners

WI-10005829 owns offer/pricing, commercial accounting/budget integration, inference qualification, operating/legal drafts, OSS preparation and assembled commercial acceptance. Existing cloud/portal/security owners retain source delivery and their live claims. WI-10005826 owns dashboard subscriptions in test mode. P-009 consumes pinned current-build proof; P-010/P-014/P-016 require actual final/customer/public artifacts.

Before real charging: measured fee-inclusive price/support costs; funded finite allowance; atomic exposure reservations and provider reconciliation; fraud/abuse and cancellation/refund handling; Papercusp LLC live payment identity/payout/tax confirmation; terms/privacy/data-processing/acceptable-use disclosures consistent with provider terms; actual support/incident contacts; hosted-account acceptance and full customer journey. The test account is measured, while live charges/payouts/tax configuration are not established by this assessment.

Before OSS publication: exact curated artifact/rights/license/notice/contributor/history/secret review plus independent clean installation. Before managed BYOC: scoped customer account, responsibility and cost matrix, no cloud double-billing and verified resource/offboarding disposition. These are item completion gates, not reasons to stop independent preparation.

## Accounting uncertainty and recurrence controls

No empirical pilot support/onboarding distribution or completed-job cost is inferred from public token prices. Quotes remain proposals until P-003 captures representative workloads and operating time. Keep price inputs versioned with source, measured-at timestamp, units and estimate/provider-billed status. Missing cost or stale artifacts produce explicit unknown/gap status.
